historical_null_policy.replay: full H through a clone of its H-fitted initial state
historical_null_policy.excluded: elapsed time, hypothetical maximizing age, persistent memory

ar_score_policy.regressors: lagged original robust-standardized input, not lagged innovations
ar_score_policy.covariance: empirical H score covariance plus 1% trace ridge
ar_score_policy.online_complexity: O(p^2 + number_of_fixed_ages*p), p <=12; AR filtering itself O(p)
ar_score_policy.null_distribution_claim: No calibrated chi-square, posterior or e-value claim; empirical ranking evidence only
